note: HAND-MAINTAINED, unlike runs/spent_windows.json which is derived from runs/experiments.jsonl. It records windows spent in DISCOVERY mode, which the derived ledger cannot see: a discovery analysis is not a backtest run and does not go through research.experiment_log, so nothing writes it down. Add a row when an analysis selects on a window; cite the .planning document that did it.
why_this_file_exists: CLAUDE.md's Discovery/Confirmation split says a designated discovery window is deliberately and permanently spent. Only confirmation spends were recorded anywhere, so a discovery-spent window read as available -- the same class of stale claim that once called KRX daily unspent the day after it was spent.
known_gap: Being hand-maintained, this file can go stale exactly as that sentence did. The real fix is CLAUDE.md guard 5's requirement that discovery trials be logged, which the rd-* Korean analyses do not meet: log_run expects fold results and an IC scan has none. Closing that needs its own change.

windows.span_note: the widest era the analysis could have read -- the store's own KRX daily range. The exact subset rd-u sampled is not recorded, and an upper bound is the safe direction.

windows.what_it_selected: investor-flow features in the same IC scan
